tool_input.command: $p='C:\Users\jjq21\.dsh\profiles\desktop'; Get-ChildItem $p -Force | Select-Object Mode,Name | Format-Table -AutoSize | Out-String -Width 120; Write-Output '--- installed version ---'; if (Test-Path "$p\node_modules\dsh-our-free-model\package.json") { (Get-Content "$p\node_modules\dsh-our-free-model\package.json" -Raw | ConvertFrom-Json) | Select-Object name,version | Format-List } else { Write-Output 'not found in node_modules' }
tool_input.description: Check desktop profile layout and installed plugin version
